key_insight: Effective Entropy measures diversity only among valid reasoning trajectories, separating useful exploration from incorrect-output noise.
engineering_relevance: VEPO offers a validity-aware exploration objective for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, aiming to improve mathematical accuracy without rewarding invalid reasoning diversity.
method: Filter incorrect trajectories out of the entropy measure.
Incorporate Effective Entropy into Validity-aware Entropy Policy Optimization (VEPO).
Adaptively increase the probability of under-explored valid trajectories.
evidence_signal: Across six math benchmarks using 1.5B and 7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models, VEPO reports aggregate accuracy gains over GRPO, competitive repeated-sampling success, and more distinct strategies on commonly solved MATH500 problems under matched correct counts, supported by paired tests and three-seed comparisons.
watch_item: The reported evidence is limited to mathematical reasoning with verifiable rewards; transfer to tasks with ambiguous correctness remains unestablished.
paper_title: The Illusion of Diversity: Aligning LLM Exploration via Effective Entropy
